question: What share of fresh meat, eggs, tofu and chay foods do urban and rural households buy in each channel in 2025 to 2026?
why_it_matters: Decides whether a meat alternative can follow the meat purchase into modern trade or must go through kitchens
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy a one-off cut of household panel data by channel and category
owner_org_to_ask: Kantar Worldpanel Vietnam (Worldpanel by Numerator); NielsenIQ Vietnam

question: What listing fees, trade margins, promotion contributions and payment terms do Bach Hoa Xanh, WinCommerce, Saigon Co.op, Lotte and AEON charge for frozen chay and processed meat?
why_it_matters: Without them no consumer product can be priced; we found no retrievable source
cheapest_way_to_close: Three buyer interviews using a supplier onboarding enquiry
owner_org_to_ask: Category buyers at MWG (Bach Hoa Xanh), WinCommerce, Saigon Co.op; incumbent suppliers SG Food, Vissan, CJ Cau Tre

question: What does frozen distribution cost per kg from a factory to modern stores in HCMC, Hanoi and Nha Trang, and what margin do distributors take?
why_it_matters: Frozen formats depend on it; also a gap in the supply study
cheapest_way_to_close: Two quotes from cold-chain logistics firms and one distributor interview
owner_org_to_ask: Cold-chain 3PLs; Vietnam Logistics Business Association; frozen-food distributors

question: How much protein and meat is in a typical factory canteen meal, what does the protein component cost, and do caterers already use chay or textured soy?
why_it_matters: Sets the cost and protein target for an ingredient in the largest price-set channel
cheapest_way_to_close: Interviews and menu sheets from three large caterers and two factory canteens
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam EOC, Hoang Kim, Vinastory, Dussmann, Thao Ha; union canteen committees (VGCL)

question: Would a large caterer run a blind trial of a blended or chay protein dish, and with what acceptance?
why_it_matters: Would give the first tested evidence in any Vietnamese channel
cheapest_way_to_close: One four-week trial at one factory with plate-waste and preference measures
owner_org_to_ask: A large caterer and a willing FDI factory; university sensory lab

question: Is Lotteria's Burger Zero Meat still on the menu, and what were its sales and repeat rates? What happened to KFC's 2018 chay menu?
why_it_matters: The only mass-chain meat-free trials; outcomes decide whether QSR is a route
cheapest_way_to_close: Menu check in five stores plus a request to the chains' marketing teams

question: Do Nha Trang hotels and restaurants report unmet demand for vegetarian or plant-based protein, and from which guests?
why_it_matters: Tests the project's HoReCa hypothesis directly
cheapest_way_to_close: Interview 20 hotel and restaurant F&B managers and audit 30 menus in Nha Trang
owner_org_to_ask: Khanh Hoa Department of Tourism; Khanh Hoa Tourism Association; hotel F&B managers

question: How many pupils eat ban tru nationally, at what meal prices, and who supplies the kitchens?
why_it_matters: Sizes the school channel beyond Hanoi
cheapest_way_to_close: Request MOET data or provincial DOET reports for Hanoi, HCMC, Da Nang, Khanh Hoa
owner_org_to_ask: Ministry of Education and Training; provincial DOETs

question: What are hospital patient meal budgets and military ration values, and how is food procured?
why_it_matters: Large price-set channels not covered here
owner_org_to_ask: Ministry of Health; Ministry of National Defence General Department of Logistics

question: What share of households own a freezer or fridge-freezer in 2024, by region?
why_it_matters: Decides where frozen formats can sell outside big cities
cheapest_way_to_close: Extract durable goods tables from VHLSS 2024

question: What is the frozen and ready-meal share of food retail, and how fast is it growing?
why_it_matters: Sizes the format most novel products would use
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy Euromonitor or NielsenIQ category data

question: How large are frozen food and protein categories on Shopee, TikTok Shop, Lazada and GrabMart?
why_it_matters: E-commerce is the test channel for premium products

question: How many international visitors, from which markets, did Da Nang, Phu Quoc and Hoi An receive in 2025 to 2026?
why_it_matters: Indian and Western vegetarian demand may concentrate there rather than in Nha Trang
owner_org_to_ask: Da Nang, An Giang (Phu Quoc) and Da Nang (Hoi An, post-merger) tourism departments

question: How many vegan, vegetarian and veg-friendly listings does HappyCow show for Nha Trang, Da Nang, Hoi An, HCMC, Hanoi and Phu Quoc?
why_it_matters: Cheap proxy for tourist-facing vegetarian supply
cheapest_way_to_close: Manual count in a browser (site blocks automated access)

question: How many halal-certified restaurants and hotel kitchens exist in tourist cities, and how many Muslim visitors arrive?
why_it_matters: Halal certification may be a cheap add-on for plant products
owner_org_to_ask: Halal certification agencies in Vietnam; VNAT

question: What volume of dried textured soy, tofu skin and gluten moves through wholesale and wet markets to households and street vendors?
why_it_matters: The only no-cold-chain route for a plant protein ingredient
cheapest_way_to_close: Interviews with three wholesale-market traders in HCMC and Hanoi
owner_org_to_ask: Binh Dien, Hoc Mon, Long Bien wholesale markets; chay ingredient importers

question: Did the April 2026 school pork case change school procurement (certified suppliers, fewer pork dishes, more chay or egg dishes)?
why_it_matters: A structural shift could open or close the school route
cheapest_way_to_close: Interview Hanoi DOET and two caterers
owner_org_to_ask: Hanoi Department of Education and Training; school caterers

question: Has the 2025 to 2026 tax and e-invoice reform measurably shifted grocery spending from traditional to modern trade?
why_it_matters: Speeds or slows the modern retail route
